# Router-name: bilibili_followers  
**Commit time:** 2026.08.11  
**Cookies?:** yes (需 cookies.json 中的 bilibili.com Cookie 登录态)  
**Author:** AI转写 / huiinyg-rusting审核 - 来源于RSShub@Qixingchen  
**Introduction:** 某 UP 主的粉丝列表  
**Address:** rssust://bilibili_followers  
**Example:** [rssust://bilibili_followers?vmid=2](/bilibili_followers?vmid=2)  
**Parameter:**  
1. **vmid**  
   Type of parameter: number  
   Default value: 无  
   Meaning: 目标用户 mid (必填)  
2. **pn**  
   Type of parameter: number  
   Default value: 1  
   Meaning: 页码  
3. **limit**  
   Type of parameter: number  
   Default value: 20  
   Meaning: 每页条数, 最大 20
